meta.title: An upcoming event can be seen but not bid on
warnings: resolved: “Verify the exact upcoming event start time value displayed in the vendor portal.” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ without recreating or searching for it.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the upcoming RFQ's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Try to enter and submit a price; this must be refused because the event has not started.
Assert that the vendor cannot submit the quote before the scheduled start time.
